title: Switch PK curves to log scale and highlight active compound
what: CMP-C 24-hour plasma concentration (~185 ng/mL) or its ratio over the next-highest compound

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: CMP-C retains 181 ng/mL at 24 h (~16x higher than the next compound, 11.4 ng/mL).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; on a log scale the exponential elimination slopes separate cleanly across three decades.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Only CMP-C stays above the 50 ng/mL therapeutic floor at 24 h; CMP-A, CMP-B, and CMP-D fall below 15 ng/mL.
